purpose: The ordinary Episode loop and controlled return boundary, reduced to what the one system Episode type (episode_runtime/episode_type.py) uses: asynchronous only, one Episode at a time, no pending, detached, suspended, redelivered or goal-revising work, and one end of an Episode (its controller's stop). Added: unit outcomes and updates in the trace, view and resume; the typed forms. The Episode type, journal, custody and every application behaviour live in episode_runtime and are not part of this library.

details: Contribution, UnitRecord, UnitView and ResumeUnit carry the unit's outcome; a child unit's ResumeUnit and Contribution also carry its EpisodeUpdate, which EpisodeUpdate.as_record/from_record restore exactly, so EpisodeView.updates, child_reports and outcomes are the same after a resume.

Episode carries parent_input and records (a read-only reader supplied by the builder); EpisodeView exposes parent_input, outcomes, records, with_unit(outcome); Episode.view_of(record) gives the closed view.
ChildEpisodeUnit has one projection callback (ChildProjection: report, outcome, controller_input) instead of separate report and credit callbacks; the callback is called once per child.
JsonRecord (a closed JSON record) lives here.

Deleted: asynchronous-ownership machinery (DeferredUnit, PendingAction, ClosedChildUnit, start_async, allow_suspension, owned-child waiting, pending acquisition/observation/return bookkeeping, failed-source accounting hooks bind_execution_context, suspension_changed, record_execution_failure), report redelivery (ReportRedelivery, ReportDeliveryError, receive_failure, delivery_contract, delivery_failures), goal revision (GoalProposal, GoalPreview, GoalState, EpochMutation, next_epoch, goal_result, Context.transition), synchronous run, run_unit_async, resume_owned_accounting_async, leaves(), model_inputs.
_record_value raises for a value that is not JSON instead of returning its repr.

Deleted with archive.py: Episode.archive_record, EpisodeRecord.archived_record and archived(), the archived branch of EpisodeRecord.as_record, Episode._archive_completed_child; UnitRecord.child_result is a ClosedRecord.
Deleted (v9): SourceEnd, END_SOURCE_FAILED, SOURCE_END_KINDS, SOURCE_END_REASONS and the end_reason field of EpisodeCompletion and EpisodeRecord, which only carried a SourceEnd kind.

Deleted (v10): END_EXHAUSTED. An Episode ends in one way only: its controller's step for a completed unit says stop (END_YIELD_STOP; EPISODE_END_KINDS has that one value). A UnitSource always returns a unit; a source that returns None raises TypeError ('an Episode source must return a unit: only the controller ends an Episode'). Stopping belongs to the yield estimator alone.
A controller step needs only a boolean stop; transitioned/transition_scope, requests_transition and the optional observe_unit port are removed.
ParentModelInputError and ParentReport.validate_model_inputs removed (the model-input boundary they enforced is gone).

Exports the typed forms, ChildProjection, EpisodeUpdate, EpisodeView, JsonRecord and ResumeUnit; no longer exports the deleted machinery (v11: also exports the concrete episode contract of episode_type.py; v9: nor SourceEnd, END_SOURCE_FAILED, SOURCE_END_KINDS, SOURCE_END_REASONS; v10: nor END_EXHAUSTED).
EpisodeBindingDeclaration gains the optional role internal_summary (an EpisodeFunctionBinding): the summary an Episode's task sees before each unit, a function of its EpisodeView.

New: the concrete episode contract (EpisodeBinding, ChildCall, ChildMessage, ModelRequest, Rejected, ToolCall, SIGNATURES, SUPPLIED_BY_FILE, YIELD_CONTROLLERS, closing_credit, checked_members), moved from episode_runtime/episode_type.py by the owner's decision of 2026-11-20 so that the structure lives in method_loop and episode_runtime is the runner. Only its imports became relative to method_loop and its interface name now reads 'method_loop.episode_type.<role>'; nothing stored in a journal or run held the old string. It also imports yield_control. episode_runtime re-exports its names for the episodes until their imports are moved.

Outdated text left unchanged: SOURCE.json scope and this file's purpose and deleted_files still name episode_runtime/episode_type.py as the place of the Episode type; it is method_loop/episode_type.py.

New: RecordForm, Field, DeclaredField, ChoiceField, SubsetField, FormError, Commission; typed request/return admission. record_refs field type and RecordForm.record_refs(admitted). RecordForm.select(names): an optional field (required=False) of a return form is a field its Episode declares it can return when asked, a commission selects among them (Commission.selection), and the selected fields become required.
Uses jsonvalue for closed copies and JSON equality.
New: the one implementation of canonical JSON, content digest, closed JSON copy and JSON equality (the journal, recording, forms, work tables and the Episode type use it).

deleted_files: durable.py (local; its commission/return/receiver-claim half deleted, its native event target half moved to gene_annotation_episode/episodic_workflow/episode_support/jobs/native_event_ledger.py)
durable_worker.py (local; ran an Episode in a detached process)
